name: Line chart
description: A line chart with a shaded area from label/value rows, the latest value shown big; changed values animate.

params.name: points
params.help: 2 to 60 rows in time order: label (e.g. a day or month), value (a number). Rows whose value is not a number are skipped

params.name: unit
params.help: Shown after the latest value, e.g. % or k or ms

params.name: from_zero
params.help: Start the scale at 0 instead of just below the smallest value
